verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
This is the air I breathe
This is the air I breathe
Your holy presence living in me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
This is my daily bread
This is my daily bread
Your very Word spoken to me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
And I, I'm desperate for You
And I, I'm lost without You

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:

And I, I'm lost without You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I'm desperate for You
I'm lost without You
